rules: Reference tokens, never raw hex values, in UI chrome.
Surfaces step from --s0 (darkest) to --s4 (lightest). Child surfaces are lighter than their parent in dark themes.
Only --accent family tokens carry the brand emerald. They are not used for focus, selection or input outlines.
Use --focus for keyboard focus and --select for selection. They are neutral.

tokens.name: --s0
tokens.usage: Page background. Darkest layer.

tokens.name: --s1
tokens.usage: Main panels and cards on the page.

tokens.name: --s2
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered rows, nested cards on a panel.

tokens.name: --s3
tokens.usage: Raised controls, selected rows (neutral), dialogs.

tokens.name: --s4
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, pressed states.

tokens.name: --line
tokens.usage: The only divider and hairline color.

tokens.name: --line-strong
tokens.usage: Single outline on floating overlays.

tokens.name: --text
tokens.usage: Primary text.

tokens.name: --text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, headings that are muted.

tokens.name: --text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, placeholders, disabled.

tokens.name: --accent
tokens.usage: Brand and the single primary action of a view. Not for focus or selection.

tokens.name: --accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the primary action.

tokens.name: --accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: --accent-soft
tokens.usage: Meaningful state tint only (never ordinary selection).

tokens.name: --accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent colored text for meaningful state (for example positive delta).

tokens.name: --focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring and input outline. Neutral, 1px to 1.5px, at least 3:1 contrast.

tokens.name: --select
tokens.usage: Selected row, card or item. Quiet neutral fill.

tokens.name: --select-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger neutral fill for pressed or range selection.

tokens.name: --danger
tokens.usage: Danger text and icons, destructive menu items, negative movement.

tokens.name: --danger-soft
tokens.usage: Subtle danger surface for non-button banners. Never for buttons.

tokens.name: --danger-solid
tokens.usage: Destructive button background (solid).

tokens.name: --danger-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.

tokens.name: --danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on destructive solid fills.

tokens.name: --warn
tokens.usage: Warning icons and amber data series.

tokens.name: --font
tokens.value: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: --mono
tokens.value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
